  #### Required Readings

  - Chatsiou, K. & Jankin Mikhaylov, S., "Deep Learning for Political Science", in

  #### Optional Readings

  - Goodfellow, Bengio & Courville, *Deep Learning*, ch. 1.
    <https://www.deeplearningbook.org/contents/intro.html>
